guide.skyresources.stage1.stage1.title: Stage 1 - The Basics
guide.skyresources.stage1.sandIsland.tex:
Keep at least one cactus and avoid spending red sand unless a recipe requires it. Shift-right click cactus to obtain early alchemy components, but expect damage.

Your first chain is {action:1}, then {action:2}. Use life infusion to multiply cactus, make cactus fruit for recovery, craft a cactus fruit needle, and work toward your first jungle sapling and dirt.

Once you have renewable cactus, a sapling, and dirt, continue to {action:3}.
guide.skyresources.stage1.lifeInfusion.t:
Life infusion uses an infusion stone in the main hand, a recipe item in the off hand, and a target block in the world. The recipe also defines the required health cost.

Check infusion recipes with {action:1}. When the setup is correct, right-click the target block and the result drops in the world. Infusion stones can also act like bonemeal on plants, costing durability and health.

Later, automate the same process with {action:2}.
guide.skyresources.stage1.knife.title: Cutting Knife
guide.skyresources.stage1.knife.text: Cutting knives break selected blocks into special drops. Cactus, stone, iron, and diamond knives follow the same player-facing role with stronger materials lasting longer.
guide.skyresources.stage1.snowIsland.tex:
Do not spend pumpkins unless a recipe or process asks for them. Shift-right click snow to gather snowballs; this gives short mining fatigue.

Build a snow golem from two snow blocks and a pumpkin so it can create renewable snow layers. Then craft {action:1}, produce {action:2}, build a mob farm for bones, and turn the route toward dirt and saplings.

When you have dirt and a sapling, move on to {action:3}.
guide.skyresources.stage1.freezer.title: Freezers
guide.skyresources.stage1.freezer.text:
Freezers turn input items into frozen outputs. The Mini Freezer is the first tier, Iron is the normal multiblock tier, and Light Matter is the high-speed tier.

Open tier recipes with {action:1} and {action:3}, inspect freezer processing with {action:2}, or view the Iron Freezer setup with {action:4}. Put input items in the top slots; results appear in the bottom slots. Iron and Light Freezers are two-block machines stacked vertically with the controller on the bottom.
Heavy snowballs and explosive heavy snowballs provide early ranged damage when snow is your main resource path.
guide.skyresources.stage1.woodIsland.tex:
Find the starting string and use it to craft {action:1}. The wood route relies on fishing until you obtain dirt and any vanilla sapling.

Keep fishing for useful junk and early resources. Once dirt and a sapling are secure, continue to {action:2}.
guide.skyresources.stage1.survFish.title: Survivalist Fishing Rod
guide.skyresources.stage1.survFish.text: The Survivalist Fishing Rod is a cheap, durable rod tuned for junk and small useful catches. Dirt and vanilla saplings are the most important early prizes.
guide.skyresources.stage1.grassIsland.te:
Grass and Garden of Glass style starts skip most of Stage 1 because they already provide dirt and tree access. Garden of Glass can also provide another path toward cobblestone.

Use this route when you want a softer start, then continue directly to {action:1}.
guide.skyresources.stage1.magmaIsland.te:
Magma island is the difficult start and is not recommended for a first playthrough. Petrified wood is limited, so burn and craft it carefully. {action:2} can help stretch petrified wood.

First, use {action:3} with Crystal Fluid to gather cobblestone. Build a mob farm, then push into {action:4} so you can craft {action:5}. The Fusion Table lets you make the saplings and dirt needed to stabilize the island.

After the bootstrap is stable, continue to {action:1}.
guide.skyresources.stage1.magmaStone.tex: Magmafied Stone checks adjacent Crystal Fluid and can create cobblestone. Surrounding more sides with Crystal Fluid increases the number of chances per tick.
guide.skyresources.stage2.stage2.title: Stage 2 - Resource Production
guide.skyresources.stage2.stage2.text: Stage 2 introduces most resource production loops. Learn the casing machines, heat sources, fusion, crucible, condenser, and early automation before pushing into advanced machines.
guide.skyresources.stage2.seeds.title: Seeds
guide.skyresources.stage2.seeds.text: Vanilla seeds and crop starters are produced from grass-based progression. This keeps island starts from depending on naturally generated villages or terrain.
guide.skyresources.stage2.casing.title: Machine Casings
guide.skyresources.stage2.casing.text:
Machine Casings host {action:1}, {action:2}, and {action:3}. Right-click a casing with the machine block to embed it, and shift-right click the casing to remove the embedded machine.

Casing variants affect values such as efficiency, fuel efficiency, and maximum HU. Structure previews show empty casings, so remember to insert the correct machine into the casing before using the structure.
guide.skyresources.stage2.combustionHeat:
Combustion Heaters run inside {action:1}. Build the multiblock, drop the recipe inputs into the chamber above the heater, then provide a rising redstone signal. A successful craft plays an explosion sound and leaves the results in the chamber or collector.

Open the heater recipe with {action:2}, combustion recipes with {action:3}, or preview the structure with {action:4}. Wooden heaters use wooden structure blocks, stone heaters use stone-like blocks, and higher tiers allow stronger solid blocks. Wooden and stone heaters cannot use the advanced controller or collector.
guide.skyresources.stage2.waterExtractor: The Water Extractor stores water, extracts it from blocks, places source water, and inserts water into compatible targets. Aqueous machines automate the same water flow later.
guide.skyresources.stage2.dirtFurnace.te: The Dirt Furnace gives early smelting access before a stable cobblestone generator or normal furnace path is available.
guide.skyresources.stage2.lavaBlaze.text: The Blaze Powder Block creates lava when heated from below. This is one early route toward a cobblestone generator before full crucible automation.
guide.skyresources.stage2.heatSources.te: Heat Sources warm blocks such as Crucibles and Blaze Powder Blocks. Fuel-based Heat Providers become stronger heat sources once casing machines are available.
guide.skyresources.stage2.heatProvider.t:
Heat Providers install into {action:1} and act as fueled {action:2}. Their tier controls allowed fuel, heat value, efficiency, and fuel speed. Casing tier can further affect heat value and fuel efficiency.

Use {action:3} to inspect heat source behavior. A redstone signal disables the provider.
guide.skyresources.stage2.rockGrinder.te: Rock Grinders break stone-like blocks into gravel, sand, crushed stone, crushed netherrack, and related processing resources. Rock Crusher automation builds on this behavior.
Metal production combines {action:1}, {action:2}, {action:3}, and {action:4}. Ore alchemical dust and Crystal Fluid drive the ingot loop; use {action:5} to preview the basic setup.
guide.skyresources.stage2.crucible.title: Crucible
guide.skyresources.stage2.crucible.text: The Crucible melts selected items into fluids when heated from below. Crucible Inserters and Fluid Droppers automate the input and output sides.
guide.skyresources.stage2.fluidDropper.t: The Fluid Dropper pulls fluid from adjacent tanks and places a source block below when it has enough fluid, making it useful for automated Crucible output.
guide.skyresources.stage2.fusionTable.te:
The Alchemical Fusion Table crafts alchemical items from material slots and an alchemical catalyst. Manual items in the material slots also define the automation filter for hoppers and pipes.

Catalyst tier affects output yield. Fractional yield is kept in the purple output progress, so a later craft can finish a stored partial result. Open fusion recipes with {action:1}.
guide.skyresources.stage2.condenser.text:
Condensers install into {action:1}. They consume a catalyst item, usually ore alchemical dust, to condense the block above the casing. Results are output below the condenser or inserted into an inventory below when space is available.

Condenser variants affect speed and efficiency, while casing variants affect efficiency. A redstone signal disables the machine. Use {action:2} to inspect condenser recipes.
guide.skyresources.stage2.crucibleInsert: The Crucible Inserter automates item insertion into a nearby Crucible through its inventory and item automation access.
guide.skyresources.stage2.combustionColl: The Combustion Collector catches results from combustion crafting so items do not block repeated crafts in the structure.
guide.skyresources.stage2.crushedStone.t: Crushed stone and crushed netherrack are cleaned through cauldron or Rock Cleaner processing to produce ore dust paths.
Dirty gems come from rock grinding and are cleaned into usable gems with water processing. Rock Cleaner automation improves the same process.
guide.skyresources.stage2.wildlifeAttrac: The Wildlife Attractor consumes energy, water, and plant matter time to spawn passive animals above the block, and redstone can disable it.
guide.skyresources.stage3.stage3.title: Stage 3 - Advanced Automation
guide.skyresources.stage3.stage3.text: Stage 3 improves earlier production with automation blocks and smarter machines. These tools reduce manual item dropping, cleaning, crushing, and water handling.
guide.skyresources.stage3.quickDropper.t: The Quick Dropper drops full stacks without a redstone pulse and stops when powered, which makes it useful for controlled machine inputs.
guide.skyresources.stage3.rockCrusher.te: The Rock Crusher automates rock grinder recipes with FE cost and an improved yield multiplier.
guide.skyresources.stage3.rockCleaner.te: The Rock Cleaner automates water-cauldron cleaning recipes, consumes water and FE, and improves output yield.
guide.skyresources.stage3.combustionCont:
The Smart Combustion Controller automates combustion without a redstone pulse. Replace one side block of a valid combustion structure and make the controller's back face the chamber center.

Set target outputs in the controller GUI; items closer to the left have higher priority. The controller crafts one set per second by default and can send results to {action:1}. Use {action:2} for combustion recipes. Wooden and stone heaters cannot use this controller.
guide.skyresources.stage3.aqueous.title: Aqueous Machines
guide.skyresources.stage3.aqueous.text: Aqueous Concentrators and Deconcentrators automate Water Extractor-style insert and extract behavior for water handling setups.
guide.skyresources.stage4.stage4.title: Stage 4 - Powerful Materials
guide.skyresources.stage4.stage4.text: Stage 4 focuses on dark matter, light matter, stronger automation, End access, and life-based machines.
guide.skyresources.stage4.integratedDyna: When Integrated Dynamics is loaded, SkyResources3 adds Life Infusion recipes for Menril Berries and Menril Saplings. Open the infusion recipes with {action:1}. Infuse light blue dye with a red mushroom for berries, then infuse those berries with a birch sapling for the sapling.
guide.skyresources.stage4.dmWarper.title: Dark Matter Warper
guide.skyresources.stage4.dmWarper.text: The Dark Matter Warper consumes dark matter fuel to transform nearby mobs and optionally affect players or animals according to config.
guide.skyresources.stage4.end.title: The End
guide.skyresources.stage4.end.text: The End Portal Core uses a multiblock structure, Ender Eye inventory, and a redstone pulse to teleport players to the End. Open the core recipe with {action:1}, preview the setup with {action:2}, then continue to the improved portal with {action:3}.
guide.skyresources.stage4.end2.title: The End - Improved
guide.skyresources.stage4.end2.text: The improved End Portal Core structure adds Silverfish Disruptors, Light Matter Blocks, End Rods, and Purpur Pillars to remove Ender Eye consumption and silverfish harassment.
guide.skyresources.stage4.healthGem.text: The Health Gem stores infused health, increases maximum health over time, and provides stored health for Life Infuser automation.
guide.skyresources.stage4.lifeInfuser.te: The Life Infuser automates {action:1} with a multiblock, {action:2}, an off-hand item, and a target block below the core. Open the core recipe with {action:3} or preview the structure with {action:4}.
guide.skyresources.stage4.lifeInjector.t: The Life Injector damages entities standing on it and stores that health in a Health Gem for later infusion work.
